verdict.rationale: Docs confirm custom images ('Custom images, any dependency') and general sandbox configurability (filesystem, networking, snapshots, GPU attachment), implying developers can define their own container image for a sandbox. However, there's no explicit documentation snippet showing a 'template' abstraction or step-by-step guide for bringing an arbitrary Docker image/Dockerfile into a Sandbox definition. missing for 10: explicit image-build/Dockerfile-based custom image walkthrough, reusable named template mechanism, independent confirmation of custom image support beyond marketing copy.
